name: kip-coop-scripts
description: Runtime deps for Kip's coop-maintenance scripts when bundled into the app (electron.wiki spawns them via ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE). better-sqlite3 is NOT here on purpose — the bundled app supplies its own (Electron ABI) copy; the repo-root package.json has it for plain-node tests/CLI. gulp's syncScripts copies scripts/*.js + lib/ into static/scripts and runs `npm install --omit=dev` here.
